summary: A10 Networks, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing quarterly dividend approval by its Board. The dividend is $0.06 per share, payable June 1, 2026 to holders of record May 15, 2026. No stated premium, deal value, or advisor is provided. Future dividends are subject to Board review and potential adjustment. The filing is a capital-return event through a newly initiated quarterly dividend program. What to watch: sustainability of the dividend and any changes to the company's capital allocation strategy.
